key.name: persistent-workspaces
key.description: The first N workspaces stay visible even when empty. Active workspace is always shown.

key.name: max-workspaces
key.description: Maximum number of workspaces to display in the indicator.

key.name: follow-window
key.description: When moving active window to another workspace (Super+Shift+1..0), automatically follow focus to target workspace (Hyprland movetoworkspace style).

key.name: filter-by-monitor
key.description: When enabled, only count windows located on the monitor where the panel indicator resides.

key.name: hide-default-indicator
key.description: Hide GNOME's built-in activities / workspace switcher dots button in the top bar.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Position of the indicator in the top panel (left, center, or right).

key.name: show-workspace-names
key.description: Display custom workspace names instead of numbers on pills.

key.name: show-tooltip
key.description: Display workspace name in a tooltip on hover.
